description.message: Every window shows the same tabs. Open a tab in any window and the live page moves there, typing, scroll and video intact.

actionTitle.message: Mirror Windows: click to turn syncing on or off

welcomeLead.message: Every Chrome window now shows the same tabs, in the same order.

welcomeHow.message: Each page is one live tab. Open it in any window and that same page moves there, with your typing, scroll position and video. The other windows keep a stand-in tab for it.

welcomePreviews.message: With previews on, a stand-in shows a blurred picture of its page. Chrome asks for access to all sites because taking that picture needs it. The pictures never leave your computer and are deleted when the browser closes. Without it, stand-ins are plain dark grey.

tipToolbar.message: Click the toolbar button to turn mirroring off or on. Right-click it for a window that isn't mirrored.

tipBookmark.message: Bookmark or copy a page's address from the window where it is live: a stand-in's address is the extension's own.

optFollowFocus.message: Bring the page over when its window gets focus. Off: only clicking the page or its tab does.
